name: OpenITI (rijal)
description: The rijal works isnady reads from the OpenITI corpus: Ibn Hajar's Taqrib and al-Najashi's Rijal.

entries.title: Taqrib al-Tahdhib — Ibn Hajar al-'Asqalani
entries.description: 8,824 narrators of the six books with Ibn Hajar's verdict, rank, tabaqa, death year and book marks; identifies the narrators in every chain. From the OpenITI corpus (licence not stated there, so kept on this computer only).

entries.title: Rijal al-Najashi — al-Najashi (Shia)
entries.description: 1,266 authors and narrators with al-Najashi's words, read on the Shia scale (thiqa, praised, muwaththaq, weak; creed: Imami, Waqifi, Fathi, Zaydi …); readable in Books. From the OpenITI corpus (licence not stated there, so kept on this computer only).
